faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our platform.

q1.question: How does the free trial work?
q1.answer: You get full access to all Pro features for 14 days, no credit card required. You can cancel anytime during the trial period.

q2.question: Can I change my plan later?
q2.answer: Absolutely! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately, and we'll prorate the billing.

q3.question: What integrations do you support?
q3.answer: We support 200+ integrations including GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Discord, Figma, Notion, and all major development tools. New integrations are added regularly.

q4.question: Is my data secure?
q4.answer: Yes, we take security seriously. We're SOC 2 compliant, use end-to-end encryption, and all data is stored in secure, geographically distributed data centers.

q5.question: Do you offer refunds?
q5.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not completely satisfied, contact our support team for a full refund.

q6.question: How does billing work?
q6.answer: Billing is monthly or annual. Annual plans get a 20% discount. You can manage your subscription and billing from your account settings.
